Sponsored by 2026 Toyota RAV4

Redefining Adulthood spotlights people who’ve discovered that making time for the things they love doesn’t distract from adulthood; it enriches it. Whether through a hobby or a career, their passions have led to purpose, community, and a life that’s uniquely their own. 

In this episode, meet Anthony Porter, the conservationist and creator known to his followers as  Outdoor Anthony, who built a profession around his love for the outdoors. He went from teaching environmental education in classrooms to inspiring hundreds of thousands of people online to get outside, protect the places they love, and see the natural world a little differently. 

Follow Anthony through South Lake Tahoe in his Toyota RAV4 Woodland for a workday that looks more like a weekend itinerary. title: The Creator Behind Outdoor Anthony Has a Workday Unlike Most People’s
